title: RODINNÝ ŠTÍT 1.3 — HOLDOUT A (sealed before first execution)
source: Original synthetic paraphrases reflecting public Czech fraud advisories (Policie ČR, ČNB, NÚKIB); no copied real victim messages, real domains, credentials or personal data
protocol: Labels are challenge-set hypotheses (scam intent→high, benign→low, unclear→moderate), not validated criminal ground truth. Evaluate against the frozen baseline once. Never tune rules on these same messages and then report resulting score as independent.
